title: OrderRequest
description:
`POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/orders`. The customer is the sandbox's persona; the prices come
from the menu version the Catalog publishes when the order is placed.

note.description: At most 140 characters, with no email address, phone number, card number or URL.

slot.description:
The pickup slot's or delivery window's start, a business time such as
`2026-11-07T09:45:00-07:00`.

zone.description: `z1`, `z2` or `z3` for a delivery; absent for a pickup.

OrderKind.description: Pickup at the counter, or delivery to a zone.

OrderLineRequest.description: One line of an order as the customer asks for it.

variant.description: A variant slug from the menu, such as `croissant/box-6`.
